subject: Urgent: Missed courier pickup causing expo freight diversion
messages:
From: Marta Park <marta@eventlogix.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodai.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodai.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodai.com>
Date: 2026-11-19T16:12:00-08:00
Subject: Export crates - courier missed pickup / urgent alternative?

Hi Ben,

Quick heads up — our contracted courier (SpeedLine) did not pick up the three crates from our downtown SF warehouse during the scheduled 14:00 window. Warehouse ops flagged that the driver arrived late, paperwork was incomplete, and the gate refused loading. They held the crates in the yard.

We need the crates at Moscone Center for booth build by 08:00 on 11/21. The BOLs are attached (BOL_2847.pdf) and warehouse photos show the pallets staged (yard_photos_11-19.jpg).

Options we're considering:
- Rebook an expedited same-day white-glove truck (costly)
- Move to an overnight LTL with morning delivery (risking missed install)
- Approve SpeedLine’s second attempt but request priority gate clearance (depends on terminal availability)

Can Redwood confirm whether we should: 1) accept SpeedLine's reattempt and send a pickup authorization, or 2) approve a third-party rush courier and I’ll run cost by the events budget immediately?

Sorry for the scramble — will loop your team for quick decision.

Thanks,
Marta
Eventlogix — Events & Logistics
attachments: BOL_2847.pdf, yard_photos_11-19.jpg
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodai.com>
To: Marta Park <marta@eventlogix.com>, SpeedLine Logistics <ops@speedline.co>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodai.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodai.com>
Date: 2026-11-19T17:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Export crates - courier missed pickup / urgent alternative?

Marta — thanks for the detail and the photos. Ben from Redwood Events team here. Quick notes:

1) Priority is installation window; cost is secondary for now.
2) If SpeedLine can guarantee delivery to Moscone by 06:00 11/21 + provide a signed pickup confirmation, we can stick with them. If not, authorize a rush partner.

SpeedLine (ops@speedline.co) — please confirm pickup reason (ETA of driver, POD if already attempted) and whether you can secure an early-morning direct-to-venue delivery. If you cannot, please provide a written rejection so we can procure alternate transport.

Marissa / Hannah — please standby for an approval to greenlight a third-party white-glove partner if SpeedLine cannot meet the 06:00 venue ETA. I will need:
- quick estimated cost (ballpark okay)
- any procurement approval required from finance (I’ll CC Finance if we exceed the standard threshold)

Ben
Redwood Inference — Field Marketing
attachments: pickup_confirm.pdf
From: SpeedLine Logistics <ops@speedline.co>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodai.com>, Marta Park <marta@eventlogix.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodai.com>
Date: 2026-11-19T19:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Export crates - courier missed pickup / urgent alternative?

Ben / Marta —

Sorry for the disruption. Investigated with onsite driver: driver arrived at 14:40, encountered gate hold due to missing COI paperwork from the shipper. Warehouse would not accept the load without updated COI number on the manifest. Driver made a photo of the yard and left a copy of the attempt (attached).

We can:
- Attempt a 20:30 same-day pickup and run a direct route to Moscone for 05:00 delivery (price estimate: $1,850)
- If we cannot access gate tonight, next earliest is an overnight LTL with 07:30 delivery on 11/21 (less expensive, $620)

We will clear the COI issue if Redwood or Eventlogix confirms authorization on company letterhead (email reply acceptable) and SpeedLine is listed as authorized carrier. If you authorize us now we will prioritize the 20:30 pickup.

Proof of attempt attached: pickup_attempt_note.jpg

— Ops, SpeedLine
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodai.com>
To: SpeedLine Logistics <ops@speedline.co>, Marta Park <marta@eventlogix.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodai.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodai.com>
Date: 2026-11-20T11:08:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Export crates - courier missed pickup / urgent alternative?

Thanks for the quick follow-up, SpeedLine — that explanation helps. We are authorizing SpeedLine for the 20:30 pickup and priority direct-to-venue routing for delivery by 05:00 on 11/21. Please proceed under the $1,850 option.

Action items and confirmations:
- SpeedLine: confirm driver name, vehicle plate, and attach signed pickup manifest once loaded. Share real-time tracking link.
- Eventlogix (Marta): confirm warehouse will accept authorization email from Redwood as proof to clear the COI hold. If not, please push the alternate white-glove approval immediately.
- Marissa / Hannah: I’ll place a $2k cap approval for expedited transport (Finance will be notified if actuals exceed). Marissa — please open an expense request with the vendor details so we can reconcile after event.

Thanks team — please keep updates coming in thread and paste the SpeedLine tracking URL when available.

Ben
Redwood Inference — Field Marketing
